buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before

bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 5 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 5 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The Seller shall supply electronics items strictly as per the specifications, make, model, and technical parameters mentioned in the Purchase Order placed on GeM portal. 2. All standard accessories, cables, power adapters, and components as required for complete and functional operation of the equipment. 3. User manuals, technical documentation, warranty cards, and certificates (BIS/ISI/etc.) in English and/or regional language as applicable. 4. Pre-delivery inspection report. 5. Products must carry valid Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification/ISI mark wherever mandatory under the Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (CRO) or any subsequent amendment. 6. Products must comply with applicable Indian Standards (IS) published by BIS or relevant international standards (IEC/ISO/IEEE) as specified. 7. The Buyer/Consignee reserves the right to inspect all items at the point of delivery before acceptance. 8. Inspection shall include verification of make/model/specifications, physical condition, completeness of accessories, authenticity of certifications, and functional testing as deemed necessary. 9. The Seller shall provide all necessary testing equipment, tools, and technical support required for inspection at no additional cost. 10. Acceptance will be formally recorded on the GeM portal by the Consignee only after satisfactory inspection. Mere physical receipt shall NOT constitute acceptance. 11. If items are found defective, non-conforming, or substandard at inspection, the Buyer shall issue a rejection notice. The Seller shall replace the rejected items within 7 working days at their own cost. 12. The Buyer reserves the right to engage an independent third-party inspection agency at any stage, the cost of which shall be borne by the Seller in case defects are found. 13. The Seller warrants that all electronics items supplied are: ● Brand new, genuine, and sourced directly from the OEM or authorized distributor/dealer. Refurbished, remanufactured, replica, duplicate, or second-hand items are strictly prohibited. ● Free from any counterfeit components, subassemblies, or firmware. Any use of counterfeit components shall lead to immediate blacklisting and criminal action under applicable laws. ● Carrying manufacturer's original serial numbers, product labels, and security holograms as applicable. ● The Seller must provide documentary evidence of authorized

dealership/distributorship from the OEM upon request by the Buyer.● The Buyer reserves the right to verif y the authenticity of any supplied item directly with the OEM. False supply shall result in rejection, blacklisting, forfeiture of security deposit, and legal action. ● Installation Completion Certificate signed by both the Seller's representative and the Buyer's designated officer must be submitted before raising the invoice. ● Any civil/electrical work required for installation shall be the responsibility of the Buyer unless otherwise specified. 14. The Seller shall provide comprehensive hands-on training to designated users on the operation, basic troubleshooting, and maintenance of supplied equipment. 15. Training shall be conducted at the Buyer's premises by qualified trainers at no additional cost. 16. Refresher training may be requested by the Buyer at any time during the warranty period and shall be provided free of cost. 17. The Seller must be registered as a Producer with the State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)/Pollution Control Committee (PCC) under the E-Waste Management Rules. 18. The Seller shall facilitate take-back of end-of-life electronics items at no additional cost to the Buyer, as per EPR obligations. 19. Products must not contain Restricted Hazardous Substances (RoHS) beyond permissible limits as per the applicable Indian/international standards. 20. The Seller must disclose any known vulnerabilities (CVE/NVD listed) in the supplied equipment and provide timely firmware/software security patches during and after the warranty period. 21. Equipment procured for classified/sensitive applications must comply with guidelines issued by CERT-In and MeitY for Government cybersecurity. 22. The Seller shall not embed any remote access, telemetry, or phone-home features without explicit Buyer consent. 23. The Seller shall supply equipment with the latest available firmware/software version at the time of delivery. 24. 24.In order to ensure quality assurance at the source and to evaluate the technical compliance and suitability of electronics items prior to finalisation of the bid/Purchase Order, the Buyer will conduct a Pre-Bid Inspection of sample items submitted by the bidding Seller. 25. 25.Submission of a sample and participation in the inspection process shall be a mandatory eligibility condition. Bids from Sellers who fail to submit the required sample or do not participate in PBI shall be summarily rejected. 26. 26.Sample Submission Date and Location . At the office of Purchasing Officer, HQ 374 Composite Artillery, Nasirabad, Rajasthan by 15 November 2026. 27. 27. Samples shall be submitted to the address/inspection centre designated by the Buyer in the bid document. Submission at any other location shall not be accepted. 28. 28.A Sample Receipt Acknowledgment (SRA) shall be issued by the Buyer/designated officer upon receipt of the sample. The Seller must preserve the SRA as proof of sample submission. .
